title: Indicator
description: One source's operationalisation of a construct: a measured quantity that can be observed for a site, area, country, or grid cell. unit is the measurement unit (how a value is scaled), distinct from the unit of analysis; a ratio indicator carries unit rate and names its denominator through denominator_indicator_id rather than folding it into the unit string. construct_id names the construct in the versioned construct vocabulary; two indicators of one construct stay separate indicators.

unit.description: Closed measurement-unit enum (ruled 2026-08-31; index and percent_point added 2026-09-05 under R-C2: index for unitless composite scores, percent_point for differences between two percentages, the unit the shipped Cambodia change metric already declares). Grows only by versioned vocabulary change; never reopened to a free string.

construct_id.description: Construct this indicator operationalises, from the construct vocabulary (construct-vocabulary.v1). Null while an indicator predates the vocabulary.

variable_kind.description: How values aggregate across units: intensive (rate, mean, index; weighted mean) or extensive (count; apportioned sum). code marks a categorical indicator that is never weighted.

native_period_type.description: The source's own period concept for a value: a calendar year, a survey fieldwork span, a pooled multi-year estimate, or a single reference date.
